coverage_limit: Xdebug line coverage is reported for two PHP groups: saloonphp/xml-wrangler src (package) and veewee/xml src (underlying delegate that drives XMLReader and decodes each matched subtree through DOMDocument). AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c, parserInternals.c, SAX2.c and xmlreader.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/xmlreader/php_xmlreader.c and ext/dom/document.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the same harness runs. libxml2 tree, save, XPath and dict code, ext/libxml, the other ext/dom classes, the Zend engine and the interpreted package PHP code add no AFL++ tuples. libxml2 parses each input twice on this path: once through XMLReader over the original bytes and once through DOMDocument::loadXML over the readOuterXml() serialization of the root element. The pinned base image does not bundle php-fuzzer; replay is per case.
